name: cannavec-science
description: Elite-tier cannabis-science plugin for the working researcher (v0.6 research-domain-breadth release). Adds four curated registries on top of v0.5 — **pain medicine** (≥ 7 rows: NASEM 2017 chapter-4 conclusive-evidence finding for chronic pain anchored to Whiting 2015 JAMA SR PMID 26103030, Stockings 2018 PAIN SR PMID 30121596, Mücke 2018 Cochrane neuropathic PMID 29513392, Boehnke 2019 J Pain MMJ cohort PMID 31237829, Andreae 2015 IPD meta-analysis PMID 25840040, de Vita 2018 experimental-pain SR PMID 30362962), **cannabis-and-psychosis psychiatry** (≥ 6 rows: Di Forti 2019 EU-GEI Lancet Psychiatry PMID 30902669, Marconi 2016 Schizophr Bull dose-response SR PMID 26884547, Vaucher 2018 Mendelian-randomization Mol Psychiatry PMID 29039420, Bhattacharyya 2009 acute-THC fMRI Arch Gen Psychiatry PMID 19996036, Hjorthøj 2023 Lancet Psychiatry Danish national-register cohort PMID 36402143, Murray 2017 Lancet Psychiatry narrative review), **driving-impairment science** (≥ 5 rows: Compton 2017 NHTSA Virginia Beach case-control DOT HS 812 411, Hartman 2015 Clin Chem plasma-THC dose-response PMID 25371545, Marcotte 2022 JAMA Psychiatry simulator RCT PMID 35138350, Brubacher 2022 NEJM BC post-legalization cohort PMID 35081282, Bondallaz 2016 Forensic Sci Int SR PMID 27082781 — the SCIENCE not the LAW per §IV), and **PTSD / anxiety / sleep** (≥ 5 rows: Bonn-Miller 2021 PLOS One PTSD smoked-cannabis RCT PMID 33667097 with the largely-negative primary endpoint honestly stated, Crippa 2011 J Psychopharmacol CBD-SAD PMID 20829306, Bergamaschi 2011 Neuropsychopharm CBD-SAD PMID 21307846, Bedi 2010 Drug Alcohol Depend biphasic acute Δ⁹-THC anxiety PMID 19897322, Walsh 2017 Sleep Med Rev SR PMID 28392485). Adds the **reporting-rigor module**: six EQUATOR-network detectors (CONSORT for RCTs per Schulz 2010 BMJ PMID 20335313, PRISMA-2020 for SRs per Page 2021 BMJ PMID 33781993, STROBE for observational studies per von Elm 2007 PMID 17938396, ROB-2 for RCT bias per Sterne 2019 BMJ PMID 31462531, ROBINS-I for non-randomized intervention studies per Sterne 2016 BMJ PMID 27733354, AMSTAR-2 for SR quality per Shea 2017 BMJ PMID 28935701) integrated into the existing rigor-check report. Adds **OpenAlex** as a thirteenth primary-source live-discovery lane (open scholarly citation graph; PubMed + preprints + conference proceedings + open citation network). Five commands; twenty curated science registries with freshness watch and cannabinoid-scoped filtering; seven cannabis-phytochemistry rigor detectors plus six reporting-rigor detectors with (detector, span) deduplication; 16 banned-pattern detectors; safety preflight; span-aware named-cannabinoid resolution; topical-relevance grade aggregation; cannabis-noun → cannabinoid-set expansion for partner-drug matching; endocannabinoidome (eCBome) registry + drug-development inhibitor pharmacology depth; identifier verification across all five Constitution §I shapes (PMID, DOI, NCT, ChEMBL, UniProt); registry inventory subcommand; honest 0-claim classification with rendered hints; retraction enforcement at composition time; live discovery across thirteen primary-source databases — PubMed, ChEMBL, ClinicalTrials.gov, PubChem, PharmGKB, RCSB PDB, Open Targets, GWAS Catalog, BindingDB, bioRxiv, medRxiv, Europe PMC, OpenAlex — with deterministic cross-source synthesis and citation-network forward-pushback analysis; researcher-workflow scaffolders (PICO, sample-size / power calculation, GRADE evidence-profile table, IRB protocol skeleton); regulatory-feasibility advisory (US / EU / Canada / UK); BibTeX/RIS/CSL-JSON bibliography export with inline GRADE annotation; registry-freshness probe. Researcher audience only. Stdlib-only Python ≥ 3.9.
